title: Bounded proper flat perfect model before lower truncation
statement: Let f:X→T be proper, locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact, with injective resolutions in X.Modules. Let F be a finitely presented O_X-module flat over f [def-pc-morphism-conventions], and U an affine open of T [def-pc-scheme]. There exist a cochain complex C of O_U-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], a∈ℤ and b∈ℕ, with C concentrated in [a,b], and all terms flat over U, quasi-coherent and finitely presented. Every pullback g*C for any scheme map g:S→U has zero homology in all negative degrees [def-pc-base-change]. For every cartesian square X′→X over T′→U→T, with injective resolutions on X′, H^q(g*C) is isomorphic to R^q f′_*(g′*F) for every q∈ℕ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. The complex need not vanish termwise in negative degrees.

proof.text: Obtain the bounded structural model from the structural-core theorem.
Apply the base-change bridge to obtain negative-homology vanishing and the higher-direct-image comparison, then assemble all conjunctions.

theorem exists_proper_flat_boundedPresentation_model {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules)
    [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] [F.IsFinitePresentation]
    (hF : F.IsFlatOver f) (U : T.Opens) (hU : IsAffine U.toScheme) :
    ∃ (C : CochainComplex U.toScheme.Modules ℤ) (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ),
      C.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ C.IsStrictlyLE b ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 U.toScheme)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (C.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
      (∀ {S : Scheme.{u}} (g : S ⟶ U.toScheme) (i : ℤ), i < 0 →
        IsZero ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology i)) ∧
      ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}} (g : T' ⟶ U.toScheme) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
        [HasInjectiveResolutions X'.Modules], IsPullback g' f' f (g ≫ U.ι) → ∀ q : ℕ,
        Nonempty ((((Modules.pullback g).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj C).homology q ≅
          (higherDirectImage f' q).obj ((Modules.pullback g').obj F))
